prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Turnip Works, heroic hand-painted miniature game art. One large freestanding temple idol: a thick curling ocean wave wrapped around a short stout three-pronged trident. Mounted on a simple low integrated pedestal. The motif is the main mass, with a bold silhouette still obvious from a high elevated tabletop camera, never hidden by a canopy. Palette: turquoise and pearl white. Stout connected forms, broad bevels, clear part separation, matte painted gradients, restrained surface texture, no glossy PBR. Exactly one complete object centered with generous clear margin, no scene or additional objects, no text, no logos, no specific published mythology or recognizable product design. Three-quarter view from ABOVE, camera elevation 50 degrees so the top and front are visible. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.
